patch_description:
Replace the random cloud with a deterministic multi-start annealed optimization for the diameter-packing objective. The optimizer works directly with all pairwise squared distances: close pairs are repelled while the currently largest pairs are pulled inward. After every step the configuration is centered and uniformly normalized, which is valid because the target ratio is scale and translation invariant.

The smooth soft-min/soft-max force is annealed from a broad pair-distance objective to a sharp approximation of the actual minimum/maximum objective. Multiple fixed-seed restarts, including a cube-plus-octahedron structured seed, make the result reproducible and substantially stronger than a single Gaussian sample. The exact unsmoothed ratio is evaluated throughout and the best 14-point configuration is returned.
